title: Turkish-style Grilled Eggplant with Caramelized Onions
description: A flavorful and aromatic side dish featuring grilled eggplant and caramelized onions, inspired by Turkish cuisine.
instructions: Brush eggplant slices with 1 tbsp olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Grill eggplant for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender.
In a large skillet, heat remaining 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat. Add sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15-20 minutes or until caramelized and golden brown.
Once eggplant is cooked, brush with a little water and add to the skillet with the caramelized onions. Toss to combine and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
